title: LookML Failures by Model
app: Looker LookML validator results and deploy events via the Looker API to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=looker:lookml_validation status="error"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by model_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts LookML failures grouped by model so operators immediately see which specific models are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'LookML is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest LookML failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical models.
visualization: Table of model by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of LookML are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
